claims.assertion: Anéeka says local Federation officials report to a Saturn-based council whose members are inaccessible and unidentified.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Anéeka says Federation bases near Saturn are mainly underground on moons and in ring asteroids, with the rings used for mineral resources.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Anéeka describes Saturn as hosting floating animal life, including giant jellyfish-like organisms and smaller prey in atmospheric ecosystems.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says the planet has no advanced civilization there.

review_flags: Claims about Federation hierarchy and Saturn environments are attributed to Anéeka.
